truth.generator: status=1, 0<barcode<200000, PDG as specified per DSID
truth.fiducial: production radius<100 mm and each of station 1/2/3 mean SiHit radii<100 mm
truth.H18: Separate reported coverage category; not required for the primary charge denominator

matching.basis: SDO majority barcode; no reconstructed charge/momentum condition
matching.ordering: Rank eligible matched candidates first, then apply Good Track to the winner; no rescue by a lower-ranked candidate

quality.historical: Alma PDF gives r<100 and exactly one Good Track; 25/7/12 thresholds are the executable source-based reconstruction, pending recovery of the original Alma analysis

uncertainty: Source-event intervals, retaining all production entries; weights report sumw2 and effective N
